scope: Numbers 1–2, all 88 public verses. Prior revisions remain unchanged.

source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact original XML verse substring, including written/read notes, not a normalized substitute.
source.public_versification_note: Public and Hebrew numbering align throughout Numbers 1–2. All 88 exact original records are hashed, including the written/read annotation at 1:16. Deuel at 1:14 and Reuel at 2:14 are retained. Later book numbering differences require separate mapping.

delta_method: F0 retained wording; F1 lexical; F2 syntax/idiom; F3 consequential interpretive, textual, social, or versification choice. Editorial assessments are separate from similarity scores. Independent review has not occurred.

verses.rationale: Leads with the exact date so the reader can place the census after the exodus, retaining Sinai and the tent as separate location details.

verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the Tent of Meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they came out from the land of Egypt, saying,

verses.rationale: Unfolds lift-the-head and by-the-skull idioms as a census and individual listing, retaining male scope and both kinship levels.

verses.rationale: Preserves the minimum age without adding an upper limit, military eligibility, both census takers and the divisional arrangement.

verses.before: All those counted of the camp of Judah were one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred by their divisions. They will set out first.
verses.after: The camp of Judah totals 186,400 registered men in its military divisions. They are to set out first.
verses.tsw_comparator: All those counted of the camp of Judah were one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred by their divisions. They shall set out first.

verses.rationale: Preserves south, standard, divisions and the same leader-father pair as 1:5.
verses.before: On the south side will be the standard of the camp of Reuben by their divisions. The leader of the Reubenites will be Elizur son of Shedeur,
verses.after: On the south, the camp of Reuben is to gather under its standard, arranged by military divisions. Reuben’s leader is Elizur son of Shedeur.
verses.tsw_comparator: On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben by their divisions. The leader of the Reubenites shall be Elizur son of Shedeur,

verses.rationale: Keeps Reuben’s exact census figure as the leading tribe of the southern camp.
verses.before: and his division, those counted, forty-six thousand five hundred.
verses.after: His force numbers 46,500 registered men.
verses.tsw_comparator: and his division, those counted, forty-six thousand five hundred.

verses.rationale: Makes the neighboring camp relationship clear and retains both personal names, including Zurishaddai’s split Hebrew spelling as one name.
verses.before: Those camping next to him will be the tribe of Simeon. The leader of the Simeonites will be Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai,
verses.after: The tribe of Simeon is to camp beside Reuben. Its leader is Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.
verses.tsw_comparator: Those camping next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon. The leader of the Simeonites shall be Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai,

verses.rationale: Preserves Simeon’s repeated fifty-nine-thousand-three-hundred total.
verses.before: and his division, those counted, fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
verses.after: His force numbers 59,300 registered men.
verses.tsw_comparator: and his division, those counted, fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

verses.rationale: Keeps Reuel as the pinned Hebrew reads here, distinct from Deuel at 1:14; a note makes the consequential name variation visible.
verses.before: Then the tribe of Gad. The leader of the Gadites will be Eliasaph son of Reuel,
verses.after: The tribe of Gad is also to camp there. Its leader is Eliasaph son of Reuel.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then the tribe of Gad. The leader of the Gadites shall be Eliasaph son of Reuel,

verses.rationale: Retains Gad’s exact final fifty in agreement with 1:25.
verses.before: and his division, those counted, forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
verses.after: His force numbers 45,650 registered men.
verses.tsw_comparator: and his division, those counted, forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.

verses.rationale: Preserves the southern subtotal and second marching position without conflating camp and tribal counts.
verses.before: All those counted of the camp of Reuben were one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty by their divisions. They will set out second.
verses.after: The camp of Reuben totals 151,450 registered men in its military divisions. They are to set out second.
verses.tsw_comparator: All those counted of the camp of Reuben were one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty by their divisions. They shall set out second.

verses.rationale: Preserves the sanctuary and Levites’ central position and the correspondence between camping and marching, without supplying a detailed transport sequence.
verses.before: Then the Tent of Meeting will set out, with the camp of the Levites among the camps. As they camp, so they will set out, each in position by their standards.
verses.after: Then the tent of meeting is to set out, with the Levites’ camp in the middle of the camps. They are to march as they camp, each in his assigned place under their standards.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then the Tent of Meeting shall set out, with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camps. As they camp, so they shall set out, each in position by their standards.

verses.rationale: Keeps west, divisional order and the named leader, with Ephraim heading this three-tribe camp.
verses.before: On the west side will be the standard of the camp of Ephraim by their divisions. The leader of the Ephraimites will be Elishama son of Ammihud,
verses.after: On the west, the camp of Ephraim is to gather under its standard, arranged by military divisions. Ephraim’s leader is Elishama son of Ammihud.
verses.tsw_comparator: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim by their divisions. The leader of the Ephraimites shall be Elishama son of Ammihud,

verses.rationale: Retains Ephraim’s forty-thousand-five-hundred count and its agreement with 1:33.
verses.before: and his division, those counted, forty thousand five hundred.
verses.after: His force numbers 40,500 registered men.
verses.tsw_comparator: and his division, those counted, forty thousand five hundred.

verses.rationale: Clarifies the pronoun’s neighboring-camp relation and preserves Manasseh’s representative and father.
verses.before: Next to him will be the tribe of Manasseh. The leader of the Manassites will be Gamaliel son of Pedahzur,
verses.after: The tribe of Manasseh is to camp beside Ephraim. Its leader is Gamaliel son of Pedahzur.
verses.tsw_comparator: Next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh. The leader of the Manassites shall be Gamaliel son of Pedahzur,

verses.rationale: Preserves Manasseh’s exact repeated figure within the western camp.
verses.before: and his division, those counted, thirty-two thousand two hundred.
verses.after: His force numbers 32,200 registered men.
verses.tsw_comparator: and his division, those counted, thirty-two thousand two hundred.

verses.rationale: Retains the third western tribe and its leader while supplying only the understood camping relation.
verses.before: Then the tribe of Benjamin. The leader of the Benjaminites will be Abidan son of Gideoni,
verses.after: The tribe of Benjamin is also to camp there. Its leader is Abidan son of Gideoni.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then the tribe of Benjamin. The leader of the Benjaminites shall be Abidan son of Gideoni,

verses.rationale: Keeps Benjamin’s total in agreement with 1:37.
verses.before: and his division, those counted, thirty-five thousand four hundred.
verses.after: His force numbers 35,400 registered men.
verses.tsw_comparator: and his division, those counted, thirty-five thousand four hundred.

verses.rationale: Preserves the western camp’s combined total and third position after the central Levite arrangement.
verses.before: All those counted of the camp of Ephraim were one hundred eight thousand one hundred by their divisions. They will set out third.
verses.after: The camp of Ephraim totals 108,100 registered men in its military divisions. They are to set out third.
verses.tsw_comparator: All those counted of the camp of Ephraim were one hundred eight thousand one hundred by their divisions. They shall set out third.

verses.rationale: Keeps north, standard, divisions and both personal names as Dan heads the final camp grouping.
verses.before: On the north side will be the standard of the camp of Dan by their divisions. The leader of the Danites will be Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai,
verses.after: On the north, the camp of Dan is to gather under its standard, arranged by military divisions. Dan’s leader is Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.
verses.tsw_comparator: On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan by their divisions. The leader of the Danites shall be Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai,

verses.rationale: Retains Dan’s exact count without replacing it with the northern camp subtotal.
verses.before: and his division, those counted, sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
verses.after: His force numbers 62,700 registered men.
verses.tsw_comparator: and his division, those counted, sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

verses.rationale: Makes the adjacent camp’s referent explicit and retains Asher’s leader and father.
verses.before: Those camping next to him will be the tribe of Asher. The leader of the Asherites will be Pagiel son of Ochran,
verses.after: The tribe of Asher is to camp beside Dan. Its leader is Pagiel son of Ochran.
verses.tsw_comparator: Those camping next to him shall be the tribe of Asher. The leader of the Asherites shall be Pagiel son of Ochran,

verses.rationale: Preserves Asher’s total in agreement with 1:41.
verses.before: and his division, those counted, forty-one thousand five hundred.
verses.after: His force numbers 41,500 registered men.
verses.tsw_comparator: and his division, those counted, forty-one thousand five hundred.

verses.rationale: Retains the final tribe’s placement with Dan and Asher and both personal names.
verses.before: Then the tribe of Naphtali. The leader of the Naphtalites will be Ahira son of Enan,
verses.after: The tribe of Naphtali is also to camp there. Its leader is Ahira son of Enan.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then the tribe of Naphtali. The leader of the Naphtalites shall be Ahira son of Enan,

verses.rationale: Keeps Naphtali’s exact total as the final individual tribal count.
verses.before: and his division, those counted, fifty-three thousand four hundred.
verses.after: His force numbers 53,400 registered men.
verses.tsw_comparator: and his division, those counted, fifty-three thousand four hundred.

verses.rationale: Preserves the northern subtotal and last rather than silently replacing it with fourth; closes divine speech before the narrative total.
verses.before: All those counted of the camp of Dan were one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They will set out last by their standards.
verses.after: The camp of Dan totals 157,600 registered men. They are to set out last, under their standards.”
verses.tsw_comparator: All those counted of the camp of Dan were one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set out last by their standards.

verses.rationale: Keeps the repeated grand total and household/division organization, without treating it as the population including women and children.
verses.before: These are those counted from the Israelites by their ancestral houses. All those counted in the camps by their divisions were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
verses.after: These were the Israelites registered by ancestral household. All those registered in the camps by their military divisions totaled 603,550.
verses.tsw_comparator: These are those counted from the Israelites by their ancestral houses. All those counted in the camps by their divisions were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

verses.rationale: Retains the Levite exception and its grounding in the prior command, while other clarifies their membership in Israel.
verses.before: But the Levites were not counted among the Israelites, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.after: The Levites were not registered among the other Israelites, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.tsw_comparator: But the Levites were not counted among the Israelites, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.rationale: Preserves compliance in both camping and departure, and retains clan and ancestral-household relationships at the closing boundary.
verses.before: Thus the Israelites did. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so they camped by their standards, and so they set out, each by clan and ancestral house.
verses.after: The Israelites did everything the LORD had commanded Moses. They camped under their standards and set out in the same order, each with his clan and ancestral household.
verses.tsw_comparator: Thus the Israelites did. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so they camped by their standards, and so they set out, each by clan and ancestral house.
